findings.planner_persistence_api: one checked production caller permits a low-churn typed FOUND/ABSENT/UNKNOWN critical path while retaining an optional non-authoritative boolean compatibility wrapper
findings.planner_corruption: invalid UTF-8 currently escapes as UnicodeDecodeError; malformed target-id JSON currently collapses to False. Target-relevant parse/decode ambiguity must be UNKNOWN
findings.portable_event_lock: Argus already has portalocker>=3 and core.file_lock.exclusive_file_lock. Current portalocker POSIX default is flock; Windows exclusive requires no pywin32, but Windows shared locks do. Reuse exclusive locking for writer/Windows and POSIX shared flock for snapshot pinning behind one event API
findings.timeout_guard: existing exclusive_file_lock has a 30s timeout whereas current event writer blocks indefinitely; do not replace writer locking without preserving authority wait semantics
findings.windows_ci: portable Windows/macOS CI covers lock helpers but not event log; add an event-log portable regression to PORTABLE_TESTS
findings.call_query: iter_call_events has the same enumerate-path/open-later rollover race and should consume the stable snapshot primitive

termination_cause: physical invocation response boundary after durable checkpoint; research frontier remains nonempty
exact_next_action: Map literal Supervisor regressions for FOUND/ABSENT/UNKNOWN including invalid UTF-8 and malformed target rows, then design the event-lock API around portalocker exclusive writer/Windows semantics plus POSIX shared snapshot pinning and add a real Windows portable event-log lock regression. Decide whether core.exclusive_file_lock should support an indefinite authority mode or whether an event-specific wrapper is safer; then migrate iter_call_events and Mission View to the same stable snapshot.
